title: Muziki na ngoma
description: Taarab, bongo flava na ngoma, na majina ya watu wanaotengeneza muziki.

words.notes: Kwa ala za muziki: play the guitar, play the drums.

sentences.target: The singer has a beautiful voice.
altTarget: The singer has a nice voice.
The singer has a good voice.

sentences.target: The band will play music tonight.
altTarget: The band will play at night.

altTarget: I am learning to play guitar.
There is a concert on Saturday.

guidebook.intro: Kutoka taarab hadi bongo flava, muziki uko kila mahali. Jifunze jinsi Kiingereza kinavyounda majina ya “mtendaji”.

phrases.target: The singer has a beautiful voice.
I’m learning to play the guitar.

tips.title: Mtendaji: -er
body: Kiswahili huongeza **m-…-ji** (**mwimbaji**). Kiingereza mara nyingi huongeza **-er** kwenye kitenzi: **sing → singer**, **play → player**, **drum → drummer**, **teach → teacher**.
Wengi huongeza **-s**: **singers**, **players**. Mengine ni tofauti: **cook** (mpishi) ni kitenzi na nomino pia.

tips.title: Listen to, play the
body: **Kusikiliza** huhitaji **to**: **I listen to music** (ninasikiliza muziki), si “I listen music”.
Kwa ala za muziki, tumia **play the**: **play the guitar** (piga gitaa), **play the drums** (piga ngoma).

culture.title: Concert
body: **Tamasha** ni **concert** au **show**. Mwisho wa wimbo mzuri, watu hupiga kelele **Encore!** au **One more!** kuomba wimbo mwingine.

stories.title: Usiku wa tamasha
stories.summary: Neema na Juma wanaenda kwenye tamasha Nairobi.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: Neema, have you heard? There’s a big concert tonight.
line.base: Neema, umesikia? Kuna tamasha kubwa leo usiku.

line.speaker: neema
line.target: Yes! My favourite singer will sing.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: And the band will play taarab music too.
line.base: Na bendi itapiga muziki wa taarab pia.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: It’s so loud… but it’s totally great!
line.base: Sauti ni kubwa sana… lakini ni safi kabisa!
